body.name: Single-hazard audit-incidence criterion
body.construction:
For \(S_k=\{j\}\), \(j\in\{k,k+1\}\cap\{1,\ldots,T\}\), and \(S_t=\varnothing\) for \(t\ne k\), define
\[
\mathsf C_1(T,k,j,B,(|\mathcal X_t|)_{t=1}^T)=1
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
\mathcal H(B)\ne\varnothing.
\]
Equivalently, \(\mathsf C_1=1\) exactly when the finite scan \(\mathsf A_1\) returns its recovery branch.  This definition does not refer to \(\operatorname{GID}\).
